rec.name: Price Breakdown (Fair Pricing Transparency)
rec.status: Done — treated as equivalent to the existing 'CRO | Global | Kostentransparenz' (cost transparency) section; reference only

what.text: A section that shows shoppers how the product price is made up. A headline and short intro sit above 4 percentage segments (e.g. 42% / 24% / 18% / 16%, or 45% / 25% / 20% / 10%). Each segment has a short label such as production, development, marketing, service or profit. The segments are shown either as a grayscale segmented bar with the active item highlighted (dotcomcanvas) or as circular photos above the percentages (hundpur). A short explanatory text or brand promise sits below, and an optional trust badge or award can be shown beside it. The ticket also suggests making the points clickable so each one can reveal more content.

why.text: Price objections often come from not seeing what the money pays for. Showing where each euro goes frames the price as fair and justified, and justifies a premium for quality. This reduces perceived risk and price resistance, and builds trust through openness. Pairing the numbers with a quality promise or award adds authority. Interactive points let curious shoppers dig deeper without cluttering the page.

how.text: Build it as a theme section with a heading, subheading and 3–5 repeatable blocks. Each block holds a percentage, a label, an optional image or icon and an optional description. Style A: a horizontal segmented bar whose segment widths match the percentages, with the active item underlined or in a darker shade and its description shown below. Style B: round images above the percentages and labels, followed by a promise text and badge image in a card. For the clickable option, each block acts as a tab or accordion trigger that swaps the descriptive text below or opens a popup. Place it on the PDP below the product info or description, and make it reusable site-wide. The ticket notes this equals the existing Cost Transparency section, so reuse that build.

items: Visual style: segmented bar vs. round image circles
Repeatable blocks: percentage, label, optional image/icon, optional description
Make points clickable to reveal more content (tab/accordion/popup)
Closing text or brand promise block
Optional card background, border radius and color scheme
Optional icon beside the heading (e.g. money bag)

dependencies.text: No special apps are needed. The percentages and labels are entered manually in the theme editor, with images or icons uploaded per block. If shown on the PDP per product, you could add metafields for per-product percentages (inference). The numbers must be real and approved by the client. The existing Cost Transparency section may already cover this.

items: Click rate on the breakdown points (if clickable)

images.caption: Dotcomcanvas: 'Faire Preisbildung' with a money-bag icon, four percentages (42/24/18/16%) with labels, a grayscale segmented bar, the active item underlined and a short description below.
Hundpur: 'Qualität hat ihren Preis' card with four round photos, percentages (45/25/20/10%) and labels, a 'Unser Versprechen' text and an award badge.
